# The pasted examples that ARE executed by a test through the comparator
# (onboarding.Compare, directly or via onboarding.Execute), per SPEC-TOOLWORK §7
# rule 7. One per line: `<test file>:<TestName> <the $ line, exactly as pasted>`
# or `<test file>:<TestName> example: <a help banner's example line>`.
#
# TestIssue2218 checks every entry: the example is a real pasted or help example;
# the named test is declared in a _test.go file of the example's tool's package;
# the test, or a test helper it calls, reaches the comparator; it carries the
# example's own command text (a string literal the example is, or begins with,
# naming at least the tool and its verb) or executes the tool's transcript of a
# doc it reads that holds the exact line; and it reads a doc the example is
# pasted in. An example is in this file or in unexecuted_examples.txt, never
# both. Moving a line from unexecuted_examples.txt to here is how that list
# shrinks.

cmd/nova-merge/firstrun_test.go:TestTESTSFirstRunIsWhatTheToolPrints example: nova-merge version
cmd/nova-sprint/table_test.go:TestTheCommandReferenceFirstRunMatchesWhatTheToolPrints $ nova-sprint table --once
cmd/nova-sprint/table_test.go:TestTheCommandReferenceFirstRunMatchesWhatTheToolPrints $ nova-sprint table --once --out sprint-table.txt
cmd/nova-sprint/table_test.go:TestTheCommandReferenceFirstRunMatchesWhatTheToolPrints $ nova-sprint table --check
cmd/nova-wake/presence_test.go:TestTheCommandReferencePresenceExampleMatchesWhatTheToolPrints $ nova-wake presence --store 100.115.99.19:6380 --bus ./bus
cmd/nova-pulse/firstrun_test.go:TestTESTSFirstRunIsWhatTheToolPrints example: nova-pulse cut --pool cmd/nova-pulse/testdata/pool.tsv --templates cmd/nova-pulse/testdata/templates --out ./cards --root ./root
